summary: Iteration 9 backend-only testing complete for the save/bookmark + reading-history refactor. 17/17 pytest tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_bookmarks_history.py. Verified: (a) all 4 content kinds (book-3d-retirement-income, mag-rmag-vol-1, article '12345', video '67890') POST to /api/user/bookmarks and /api/user/history as STRING post_ids and round-trip through GET intact (post_id/title/type/category/image + created_at/updated_at preserved, no MongoDB _id leak); (b) GET /api/user/bookmarks and /api/user/history return most-recent first; (c) GET /api/user/bookmarks/ids returns all 4 as strings; (d) POST /api/user/bookmarks is idempotent — duplicate post_id updates the existing doc (unique index on user_id+post_id, upsert) with no duplicate row; (e) DELETE /api/user/bookmarks/book-3d-retirement-income (path param with dashes and letters) removes just that entry; (f) history progress floats (0.15, 0.5, 0.9, 1.0) survive round-trip exactly; (g) all 6 endpoints return 401 without a Bearer token AND with a bogus token; (h) startup migration works end-to-end: seeded {post_id: 55555} (int) directly in Mongo, restarted backend via supervisorctl, and verified the doc was rewritten to post_id: '55555' (str) — same for history with 77777. Auth was seeded directly in Mongo (users + user_sessions) per instructions since app is Google-OAuth-only; test docs cleaned up via fixture teardown. IMPORTANT run instruction: this file must be run with `-n 0` (serial) because TestPostIdMigration restarts the backend and would race with parallel classes under pytest.ini's `--dist loadscope`.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:155-169 BookmarkIn.post_id and HistoryIn.post_id are correctly typed as `str` — Pydantic will coerce numeric JSON to string, which is the desired behavior for legacy int payloads from older frontend builds.

server.py:444-448 & 486-490 both use `update_one({user_id, post_id}, {$set: doc}, upsert=True)` backed by the unique compound index at server.py:915-916 — clean idempotency guarantee, verified in test_add_is_idempotent_upsert.
server.py:452 DELETE route uses `post_id: str` path param — FastAPI passes the raw string, so dashes/letters like 'book-3d-retirement-income' work with no URL-encoding needed. Verified.
server.py:918-926 startup migration is bounded to `post_id: {$type: 'int'}` and iterates async cursor — safe and idempotent (subsequent restarts find no int docs). Verified end-to-end.
server.py:186 `db.users.find_one(..., {'_id': 0})` and lines 428/462/469 all exclude MongoDB _id from responses — verified test_list_returns_all_four_with_fields asserts `_id` not in response.
